title: SG-8.2.3 Block submit and disable Send at zero quota
summary: When remaining quota is 0, show an inline message, disable Send and skip the backend call
description: Context: ContributionSheet computes remaining = MAX_PER_PLAYER - sent entries but never uses it to gate submit. Desired behavior: at remaining 0 the sheet shows 'You have used all your suggestions this round', Send is disabled and handleSubmit returns early without calling submitContribution. Expected result: a player with no quota cannot submit. Why: avoids a wasted backend call and tells the player why.
acceptance_criteria: Given remaining quota is 0, when the sheet is open, then the text 'You have used all your suggestions this round' is shown inline
Given remaining quota is above 0, when the sheet is open, then that message is absent
Given remaining quota is 0, when the sheet renders, then the Send button is disabled and a submit event does not call submitContribution
technical_constraints: Reuse the existing remaining value in game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx
Use the real client module and mock it in tests; no mock data in product code
definition_of_done: Both requirements are delivered with their Act and Verify units
non_functional: Message is exposed with role alert for accessibility
